CHEMISTRY — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHEMISTRY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Acids and bases? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Acids and bases.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids and bases.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Acids and bases.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Acids and bases.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Periodic Table ● Development of the periodic table . ● Ion formation . ● For? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Periodic Table ● Development of the periodic table . ● Ion formation . ● For.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Periodic Table ● Development of the periodic table . ● Ion formation . ● For.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Periodic Table ● Development of the periodic table . ● Ion formation . ● For.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on The Periodic Table ● Development of the periodic table . ● Ion formation . ● For.

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Periodicity ● Trends in groups I, II, VII, VIII and period 3 ● gradation in size? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Periodicity ● Trends in groups I, II, VII, VIII and period 3 ● gradation in size.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Periodicity ● Trends in groups I, II, VII, VIII and period 3 ● gradation in size.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Periodicity ● Trends in groups I, II, VII, VIII and period 3 ● gradation in size.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Periodicity ● Trends in groups I, II, VII, VIII and period 3 ● gradation in size.

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

10. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Atom? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on The Atom.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Atom.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Atom.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Atom.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Atom 1.3. The periodic Table 1.4. Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Phys? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Atom 1.3. The periodic Table 1.4. Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Phys.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on The Atom 1.3. The periodic Table 1.4. Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Phys.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Atom 1.3. The periodic Table 1.4. Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Phys.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Atom 1.3. The periodic Table 1.4. Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Phys.

14. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Acids and Bases 2.2. Introduction to Salts 3.0 Organic Chemistry Page 15 of 40 1? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Acids and Bases 2.2. Introduction to Salts 3.0 Organic Chemistry Page 15 of 40 1.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Acids and Bases 2.2. Introduction to Salts 3.0 Organic Chemistry Page 15 of 40 1.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids and Bases 2.2. Introduction to Salts 3.0 Organic Chemistry Page 15 of 40 1.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Acids and Bases 2.2. Introduction to Salts 3.0 Organic Chemistry Page 15 of 40 1.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Physical Chemistry 2.1. Acids and Bases 2.? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Physical Chemistry 2.1. Acids and Bases 2..
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Physical Chemistry 2.1. Acids and Bases 2..
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Physical Chemistry 2.1. Acids and Bases 2..
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Physical Chemistry 2.1. Acids and Bases 2..

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain The Atom 1.3. The periodic Table 1.4. Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Phys and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain The Atom and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain The Periodic Table ● Development of the periodic table . ● Ion formation . ● For and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Physical Chemistry 2.1. Acids and Bases 2. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Chemical Bonding ● valence electron in bonding ● bond type (ionic, covalent, dat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Periodicity ● Trends in groups I, II, VII, VIII and period 3 ● gradation in size and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
